description: This file defines the 'RetrieveResources' command class, used to retrieve resources associated with a specific policy ID and label within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for instantiating the command, parsing from JSON, and accessing command properties.

classes.name: RetrieveResources
classes.description: An immutable command class for retrieving resources based on a policy ID and label, with JSON serialization/deserialization capabilities, and resource path construction.

methods.name: RetrieveResources.of
methods.description: Creates a new RetrieveResources command with typed PolicyId, Label, and optional headers.

methods.name: RetrieveResources.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a RetrieveResources instance from a JSON string or object.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the policy entry to retrieve resources from.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the policy ID associated with this command.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Constructs the JSON pointer path for the resources within the policy label.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the command's payload to a JSON object builder, respecting schema versioning.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of the command with updated headers.
